name: bracket-chord-control
description: control. Identical to bracket-chord-switches-tab with the chord REMOVED, to tell 'the chord switched the tab' apart from 'startup opened both rows anyway'. Without this the other scenario's evidence is only that two tabs exist, which proves nothing about the key.

actions.note: let the window finish first paint and the sidebar announce itself
ssh-launched Atrium is not frontmost on a clean snapshot
the row opens and the page starts loading

assertions.label: nothing-reaches-the-next-row-on-its-own
assertions.desc: The other half of the pair. Startup opens the active row alone, so the fixture's shared test host must commit exactly once here - measured: this run loads tab 1 alone while the chord run loads tab 1 and tab 2, which would push this past 1.

assertions.label: still-one-window
assertions.desc: Liveness, and a guard against the chord reaching something that opens a window.
